# Recall dev set (L6 tuning only)

The ranking of the session brief and prompt-time recall (plan L6) is tuned on this set. The gates are measured on the held-out corpora in `../../corpora/brief-relevance` and `../../corpora/prompt-recall`, which tuning never reads item by item.

- **Written 8 Nov 2026** by a clean-room agent (Claude Opus 5.5) from a short brief: the held-out schema and the kinds of traps, other stacks (Django + Celery, Kotlin Android, Elixir Phoenix, Rails, C++/CMake, SvelteKit; Spring Boot batch, Flutter, Laravel). It read no repo code and no held-out file.
- **`brief/<project>/`:** `context.json` (`name`, `stack`, `branch`, `recent_paths`, `recent_commits`, `session_cwd`), `notes.jsonl` (24 notes: `id`, `text`, `created`, `kind`), `expected.json` (`relevant`, `irrelevant`, `neutral`, `reasons`). Each project has exactly 3 stale notes, each older than the note that replaces it. Reference date 2026-11-01.
- **`prompt/`:** `notes.jsonl` (72 notes, 3 projects) and `prompts.jsonl` (60 prompts: `relevant`, `acceptable`, `note`); 15 prompts should recall nothing.
- Everything is invented. It is not frozen: a fix to a label is fine, with a line in the plan's L6 design log.

## Dev set v2 (brief-2/, prompt-2/)

- **Written 15 Nov 2026** by a clean-room agent (Claude Opus 5.5). It read only this README and one file of each kind in `brief/` and `prompt/` to copy the schema; no repo code, no held-out corpora. Projects, stacks, wording and note topics are new.
- **`brief-2/<project>/`** (same schema as `brief/`, reference date 2026-11-01): relaybox (Go gRPC + pgx + Kafka, `feat/`), tallyhq (Next.js 15 + Prisma + Stripe, on `main` with 6 recent commits), vesper-serve (FastAPI + async SQLAlchemy + ONNX Runtime, `fix/`), dotsy (Rust CLI, `feat/`, only 6 recent paths and 4 commits), hollowreach (Unity/C#, `fix/`), stratus-infra (Terraform + Terragrunt on AWS, `feat/`). 144 notes (22-26 per project): 54 relevant, 59 irrelevant, 31 neutral. Exactly 3 stale notes per project, each older than its replacement (gaps from ~4 months to ~2 years; some replacements say "now"/"moved", some don't).
- **`prompt-2/`:** `notes.jsonl` (72 notes: harborpay = ASP.NET Core 8 + EF Core + SQL Server, lumen-etl = Airflow + dbt + Snowflake, pocketfit = SwiftUI + SwiftData iOS) and `prompts.jsonl` (60 prompts, 20 per project; 47 relevant labels; 2 prompts with two relevant notes; 15 should recall nothing).
- **Judgment calls:** on `main` (tallyhq) a note counts as relevant only when it matches one of the recent commits; deploy/test/commit conventions stay neutral even there. Generic workflow notes that this work happens to use (Atlantis applies, uv, tflint) are neutral, not relevant. Traps that share a word or path with the work but are about another area (ElastiCache "parameter group", the DB AsyncSession vs ONNX InferenceSession, tenant.proto, the RDS storage alarm) are irrelevant. In prompts, `acceptable` holds notes a reader would not mind (e.g. the test-stack note for "write a unit test"); two no-recall prompts have acceptable notes.
